listing.name: OhMyStars
listing.abstract: This mod adds constellation lines between stars in KSA!
listing.description:
This mod adds constellation lines between stars in KSA!

Features: 
- Constellation (Asterism) Lines between stars  
- Constellation Boundary lines (IAU defined) - Star informational window  
- Star names and informational window  
- Vehicle orientation mode to point towards stars  

![OMShunter](ksa-image:OMSHunter)

A pointer can be enabled showing the direction to a currently selected star.  A navball marker can be enabled showing the orientation where the selected star is in relation to your vehicle's pointing!

![OMS3medium](ksa-image:OhMyStars3)

An orientation mode can be activated making the flight computer aim your vehicles towards the currently selected star!  Toggle the mode off to go back to the vehicle's previous orientation mode!

![OMS3medium](ksa-image:OhMyStars4)
